findings.source_quote: “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?” (Ps 137:2-4). ... “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord … And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Col 3:16, 23).

findings.translation_quote: “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. findings.source_quote: When we open our mouths and stretch our vocals in praise, we enact the grace of God.

findings.translation_quote: Quando abrimos nossas bocas e esticamos nossos vocais em louvor, reivindicamos a graça de Deus.

findings.source_quote: It is their waking thought as morning guilds the sky

findings.translation_quote: É seu pensamento ao despertar enquanto a manhã cobre o céu
